title: "Beads-on-a-string" Star Formation Tied to One of the Most Powerful Active Galactic Nucleus Outbursts Observed in a Cool-core Galaxy Cluster
question: How do the cooling ICM, an AGN outburst, the warm ionized gas, cold molecular gas and the 'beads on a string' star formation relate in the merging cool-core cluster SDSS 1531?

what.value: Systemic redshift z = 0.3350 ± 0.0002 of southern BCG

evidence.quote: used archival SDSS spectroscopy centered on the southern BCG’s nucleus to pin the stellar redshift to $z = 0.3350 \pm 0.0002$

what.value: Strong-lensing mass profile of the cluster

evidence.quote: The strong-lensing analysis yields a cylindrical mass of $M(<R_E) = 2.32 \pm 0.01 \times 10^{13} M_\odot$

what.value: Empirical dust opacity kappa_500um = 0.051 m^2/kg, beta = 1.8

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration then CLEAN, testing weighting, channel width and uv-taper
key_parameters: natural weighting, 20 km/s channels, no taper

recipe.method: bettermoments quadratic fit after smoothing and S/N clipping
assumptions: systemic velocity cz = 100,430 km/s (southern nucleus, z=0.3350)

recipe.method: Fit four-component Gaussian to aperture spectrum, convert integral to H2 mass with CO-to-H2 factor
assumptions: X_CO = Milky Way disk value 2e20 cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1, ~30% uncertainty

recipe.method: 2-sigma continuum upper limit converted to dust mass via modified blackbody

recipe.goal: Compare CO with Halpha and test free-fall and ram-pressure scenarios
recipe.method: Reproject ALMA maps onto GMOS grid for velocity difference; Hernquist free-fall model on PV diagram; ram-pressure separation timescale
key_parameters: free-fall: inclination 72 deg, v_ICM +600 km/s, drop height 16 kpc
assumptions: Hernquist potential, M ~1e13 Msun within 30 kpc

evidence.quote: yielded an emission integral of $\sim 1.7 \pm 0.3$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
these results give a $H_2$ gas mass of $(3.7 \pm 0.7) \times 10^{10}\text{ M}_\odot$
we obtain a maximum dust mass of $3.7 \times 10^8$ M$_\odot$
we place $2\sigma$ upper limits of $4.87 \times10^{-4}$ mJy beam$^{-1}$ on the continuum
we use Equation (2) in (cite: kennicutt_global_1998) to obtain a total SFR of $0.60 \pm 0.009$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$
we obtain a cavity enthalpy of $\sim 1 \times 10^{61}$ erg

answer_key.quantity: CO velocity offset from southern BCG

evidence.quote: significantly redshifted by $\sim +700$ km s$^{-1}$ with respect to the stellar velocity of the southern BCG
